description: A local socket for AI agents (MCP): requests are answered by the open Ember window. Off until the user enables it.

functions.name: start
functions.description: Open the socket (only the user's account can connect). Returns its path.

functions.name: installServer
functions.description: Write Ember's MCP server (its text) beside the socket, and refresh a copy where older versions kept it. Returns its path.

functions.name: running
functions.description: The socket's path while it's open, else null.

functions.name: reply
functions.description: Answer a request (JSON: { result } or { error }). False when another page answered first.

events.name: onRequest
events.description: An agent's request: answer it with reply(key, …).
